# sigma_user_attribute (Resource)

A Sigma user attribute. Sigma supports only string-typed attributes today; assign values to teams and users via `sigma_user_attribute_team_assignment` and `sigma_user_attribute_user_assignment`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sigma_user_attribute" "region" {
  name          = "region"
  description   = "Region scope for row-level security."
  default_value = "global"
}

resource "sigma_user_attribute_team_assignment" "analytics_region" {
  user_attribute_id = sigma_user_attribute.region.id
  team_id           = sigma_team.analytics.id
  value             = "us-east"
}

resource "sigma_user_attribute_user_assignment" "alice_region" {
  user_attribute_id = sigma_user_attribute.region.id
  user_id           = sigma_member.alice.id
  value             = "eu-west"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Attribute name. Used by Sigma when querying datasets and applying RLS rules.

### Optional

- `default_value` (String, Sensitive) Default string value applied when neither team nor user assignment matches. Marked Sensitive because UA values commonly carry tenant IDs, region scopes, or PII-adjacent identifiers used for row-level security.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) User attribute UUID.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_user_attribute.example '<user_attribute_id>'
```
